elements.manual_reason: No candidate box covers the rounded selection pill behind the first row; it fades in with the row.
elements.label: Selected-row highlight pill

pattern.description: Clipboard-history results populate top to bottom under the 'Today' header: each row (thumbnail + filename) fades and rises in, a beat after the previous one, and the first row lands with its selection pill.
pattern.why_premium: Short, tightly staggered row entrances (roughly 80-100 ms apart) make an empty launcher feel instantly alive without a hard pop; the selection pill arriving with row one tells the viewer where focus is before any narration.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo('.row', {autoAlpha: 0, y: 12}, {autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.out', stagger: 0.09}); tl.fromTo('.row.selected .pill', {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.out'}, '<');
build_hint.remotion: Per row i: const p = spring({frame: frame - i * 3, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 170, mass: 1}}); opacity = p; translateY = interpolate(p, [0, 1], [12, 0]). Selection pill opacity follows row 0's spring.

notes: Filmstrip thumbnails show the panel at alternating horizontal offsets between frames, likely a crop artefact of the strip; camera verdict is none so no camera move is reported. A slight panel drift may also occur but was not listed. Row 3 is cut off at frame bottom.
